27561.name: PITAKA Air Case For Apple Watch Ultra Series 49mm (600D Black/Grey-Twill)

bullets.title: Slim And Light
bullets.text: Measuring a mere 0.6mm and weighing just 1.5g, the Apple Watch case provides uncompromising protection and comfort without adding bulk.

bullets.title: Armored Protection
bullets.text: Crafted from aerospace-grade aramid fiber, the PITAKA Apple Watch case guarantees enduring strength that armors your Apple Watch from scratches and impacts.

bullets.title: Seamless Fitting
bullets.text: Precise cutouts seamlessly fit all buttons and functions and maintain the sleek aesthetics of your Apple Watch.
Compatible with Apple Watch Ultra 2/Ultra/Series 10/9/8/SE/7.

bullets.title: Effortless Charging
bullets.text: The Apple Watch case is ergonomically designed to let you wirelessly charge the device without removing the case, offering all-around ease.

27575.name: PITAKA Apple Watch Carbon Fiber Watch Band (Modern)

bullets.text: World's first watch band with 100% carbon fiber links compatible with all Apple Watch models including Series 11-1, SE3/SE, and Ultra 3/Ultra 2/Ultra.
Rare and durable 1K carbon fiber.
Adjustable watch band bracelet length.
Lightweight and comfortable.
Patented secure magnetic clasp.

27586.name: PITAKA AirPods Pro 2 Aramid Fiber Case (1500D Black/Grey-Plain)

bullets.title: Dual-Touch Elegance
bullets.text: Experience refined contrast at your fingertips. A supple leather top for smooth comfort, paired with a precision-woven aramid fiber base for texture and strength. Two materials. Singular elegance.

bullets.title: Tough Outside, Gentle Inside
bullets.text: — Eco-friendly PU leather, Aramid fiber exterior, Electroplated exoskeleton frame, Anti-scratch silicone module.

bullets.title: Snap On. Power Up. Go
bullets.text: Built-in with precision N52 magnets for perfect MagSafe alignment and effortless wireless charging of your AirPods Pro 2.

bullets.title: One Pattern. All Devices
bullets.text: Inspired by PITAKA's Classic Texture, Unified Design. The color perfectly complements your phone case, creating a refined and distinctive look.

bullets.title: Acoustic Channeling Design
bullets.text: No noticeable speaker holes. All-in-one design. Built-in acoustic channels ensure sound flows freely, while the case stays seamless. Enjoy uninterrupted audio with a flawless look.

27619.name: PITAKA Iphone 16 Pro Edge Case (600D Black/Grey-Twill)

bullets.title: Aerospace-Grade Aramid Strength
bullets.text: Made from aerospace-grade aramid fiber, which is 5x stronger than steel and weighs just 1/5 as much. It's ultra-thin, incredibly tough, and built for premium protection without the bulk.

bullets.title: Premium Weave
bullets.text: Crafted from finely woven aramid fiber, our case offers a silky-smooth, luxurious texture you can feel. It's not just light and strong — it's a pleasure to hold, every single time.

bullets.title: Paper Thin & Feather Light
bullets.text: Offers a sleek, barely-there profile that preserves your phone's original feel. Ideal for minimalists seeking elegant protection without added weight.
